title: Etler Hub
features:
Etler Hub is a hub for A Universal Time. The free version is keyless - paste it, run it, keep it. Farms mobs and bosses, runs quests...

SHOWCASE
Auto Lost Crate + Auto Camellite: https://streamable.com/x1goyq
Camellite Golem auto-parry: https://streamable.com/kkiav4

FREE VERSION - NO KEY, NO EXPIRY
Paste the script below and it runs. No key system, no ticket, no trial timer. Yours to keep.

Free includes: mob & boss farm, quests, items & economy, stats & traits, skin recycling, teleports, combat helpers, performance tuning, save/load configs.

Paid adds (from $4): Boundless Tower, the Trait Kaitun that farms traits while you sleep, spec unlocks (Chainsaw Hybrid, C-Moon, Made In Heaven,...), and multi-target farming instead of one at a time.

WHAT IT DOES
Every feature below is tagged with the version it comes in:
[FREE] = the keyless script   
[PAID] = from $4   
[PREMIUM] = separate subscription

[FREE] Aerial & Ground Auto-Farm
Mobs and bosses on autopilot (one target at a time on free, multi-target on paid) with built-in combat assists, including a live parry engine for the Camellite Golem.

[FREE] Full Economy Automation
Khronos Lab reputation, rank rewards, skin recycling and forging, and auto-sell.

[FREE] Everything Else
Auto-Stats, Auto-Traits, Quests, Area Teleports, Combat Helpers, Physics Overrides, FPS and performance tuning, Save/Load configs, quick menus.

[PAID] Farms The New Combat Specs
Chainsaw Hybrid and the other new-system specs can't be auto-farmed by most scripts - they simply don't attack. Etler Hub farms them properly.

[PAID] One-Click Spec Unlocks
Standless to Chainsaw Hybrid in about 10 minutes, completely hands-off.

[PAID] Hands-Free Trait Farming (Kaitun)
Drop in a config and walk away. Auto-swaps your stands and specs, farms your exact target traits, and a Discord webhook alerts you the moment a Godly or Hexed trait lands.

[PAID] Boundless Tower
Full tower automation: farm waves, skip waves and floors, collect chests, pick upgrades, apply stats, auto-ascend and auto-sell.

[PREMIUM] For The Delta Fully Automated
No other AUT script does this. Etler Hub runs the entire "For The Delta" chain on its own: start to finish, unattended, then repeats. Separate subscription; ask in the Discord.

Built to run AFK overnight. Regular updates, active support.

SUPPORTED EXECUTORS
Confirmed working: Potassium and Volt (paid), Madium, Delta and Project Real (free). Any executor with solid sUNC that runs Luarmor scripts will work.
Does NOT work on Solara or Xeno - their sUNC is too weak to run it.
